angle: Adult children in Sri Lanka sending a meaningful fragrance to their mother without waiting for a special holiday or making a long trip across town.
audience: Parents - local (Sri Lankan adult children gifting their mother within Sri Lanka)
supporting_line: Delivered to her door anywhere in SL.
scene_prompt: Eye-level 4:5 portrait studio product photograph on a pure flat #FFFFFF seamless white background, cutout-on-ground framing with no frame border, no horizon, no panel seams, and no visible picture edge. Positioned strictly inside the centered inset hero area (x=15% to 85%, y=32% to 84%), a clean horizontal cluster of the three real women's fragrance products drawn exactly as they appear on the attached product sheet — matching identical bottle shapes, caps, colours, glass textures, boxes, and printed typography: on the left, the round pink glass Bvlgari Rose Goldea Blossom Delight bottle with its clear circular cap alongside its blush-pink box; in the center, the rectangular peach-amber glass Dolce And Gabbana The Only One bottle; on the right, the bright yellow pebble-shaped Bleu Blanc Tara Vous bottle beside its yellow-and-white floral box. The bottles stand upright on an invisible seamless surface with soft, natural contact shadows strictly contained inside x=15% to 85% and y=32% to 84%. Even, crisp studio lighting highlights the clear glass and gold-toned details without harsh glare. Contains no logos, typography, text, or props.
why: Local adult children often put off gifting their parents due to busy schedules, so pairing a simple 'just because' reminder with island-wide doorstep delivery makes thoughtful gifting effortless.
